title: French Soufflé Rice Bowl
description: A classic French-inspired dish featuring a fluffy soufflé on top of a bed of flavorful rice.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix together the herb blend, thyme, and parsley.
Add the mixed herbs to the cooked rice and stir to combine.
In a greased 1-quart soufflé dish, arrange half of the rice mixture.
Top the rice with the soufflé mix, spreading it evenly.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the soufflé is puffed and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the soufflé over the remaining rice mixture.
